details.description: Flavorful Lip Balm: One 0.15 Oz. Lip Balm Tube Of Burt’S Bees Beeswax Lip Balm To Moisturize And Soften Your Lips Each balm is infused with responsibly sourced beeswax, vitamin E and nourishing oils for a conditioning lip treatment that keeps your lips happy, healthy and juicy A hint of peppermint oil gives a one-of-a-kind refreshing tingle that will encourage you to apply this flavored lip balm over and over again The tint-free tube of moisturizing lip balm glides on your lips smoothly to nourish them, keeping lips happy, healthy and hydrated

Lip care: bursting with sweet vanilla flavor, refresh and nourish your lips with vanilla bean Burt's Bees Moisturizing Lip Balm Total hydration: hydrate and soften dry lips with beeswax and fruit extracts packed into every tube of Burt's Bees Lip care Moisturizing: just one swipe of this conditioning lip moisturizer leaves your lips smooth and refreshed All Natural: enriched with 100% natural ingredients, this natural lip Balm is formulated without parabens, phthalates, petrolatum or SLS

Refreshing Flavor: Cool cucumber paired with a hint of crisp mint provides a pleasant, invigorating scent and taste that encourages frequent use. Hydrating Formula: Infused with cucumber fruit extract, responsibly sourced beeswax, nourishing oils and natural butters, this balm helps moisturize dry lips and prevent chapping. Natural Ingredients: Formulated without parabens, phthalates, petrolatum or sulfates (SLS) and made with ingredients of natural origin for gentle everyday care. Smooth Application: The tint-free balm glides on easily, leaving a matte finish while locking in moisture.

Ultra Conditioning lip balm melts onto lips to replenish skin. Conditions and hydrates with rich butters and oils including kokum, shea and cocoa butter. 100% natural origin, formulated without parabens, phthalates, petrolatum or SLS.
A luxurious, hydrating lip balm with mango butter, known to naturally nourish, leaving lips feeling soft and hydrated. 100% natural.
Nourishing and hydrating lip balm with the goodness of pomegranate oil. 100% natural.

Sheer colour tinted lip balm with up to 8 hours of moisture. Easy to apply, no mirror needed. Hydrates and soothes dry lips with moisturising shea butter and botanical waxes, enriched with 100% natural origin ingredients.
